next_steps: Choose an actually returned slots[].slotId, then pass it as slot_id to hold_slot.
Pass that call's returned hold_id and optional guest_fixture_id to prepare_demo_booking; default is guest-001. Read its backend recap and ask for consent.
Wait for a subsequent affirmative final user transcript, then call confirm_slot_booking with only hold_id. The server binds the fixture guest and scopes its email to the call_id.
For cancellation in the same call, require explicit final user cancellation intent, then use the returned booking.id as booking_id.
Do not use fixture_id as a slot, hold, customer or booking ID. The telephone worker supplies write keys.
